title: Rapid evolution of AI disciplines
caption: Every stage runs on the same language model; what changes is how we reach it, and how much work it takes on.

prompting.description: ChatGPT launched on 30 November 2022 as a model that talks in a conversation [1]. Prompting means writing instructions so the model reliably gives you what you need [2]. That it became a discipline in 2022–23 is my reading of those dates.

agents.description: Anthropic defined agents in December 2024 as language models that direct their own tool use [1], and launched Claude Code in February 2025 as its first agentic coding tool [2]. Models used tools from late 2022 on in research; 2024–25 is when agents became everyday tools.

anthropic-claude-code.title: Anthropic, Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code

workflows.description: LangGraph shipped in January 2024 to build agent steps as a graph whose structure people still decide [1]. In December 2024 Anthropic named this a workflow: model and tool steps along a path fixed in advance [2].

factory.description: Dan Shapiro described the "dark factory" in January 2026: a black box that turns specifications into software [1]. In February 2026 StrongDM published its Software Factory, where no person writes or reviews the code [2]. The term is young and not yet settled.

shapiro-five-levels.title: Shapiro, The Five Levels: from Spicy Autocomplete to the Dark Factory
